evidence.summary: Official Codex CLI reference documents the stable non-interactive exec interface.
The release builder did not have a Codex executable; no upstream binary version is certified.
Installation remains a machine-local preflight concern.
Official authentication flows are documented, but no account session is included or certified.
The adapter invokes codex exec non-interactively and sends the prompt through stdin.
The adapter consumes the documented --json JSONL event stream.
Unit tests lock safe invocation flags, JSONL result parsing, usage capture and failure mapping.
The adapter sets an explicit working directory; a live vendor-runtime conformance run is still required.
workspace-write is the default sandbox, but filesystem effects are not yet certified across platforms.
CHG terminates the spawned process tree; native Codex cancellation semantics are not yet mapped.
The v0.3 alpha adapter is deliberately ephemeral and does not expose exec resume.
The adapter defaults to workspace-write; isolated worktree orchestration is not yet implemented.
CHG converts the final response into a SHA-256 evidence artifact.
Usage is forwarded when present in turn.completed events; normalization is not yet certified.
Gateway events and artifacts bind trace, job, run, adapter and native session identities.

blocking_gaps: Pin and record a tested upstream Codex CLI version.
Run authentication and health probes without exporting credentials.
Pass Linux, Windows and macOS live-runtime conformance evidence.
Verify cancellation, workspace effects and upgrade/rollback behavior.
decision: Eligible for CONFORMANCE_PARTIAL only; not ready for production certification.
